entities.summary: Vladas Zajančkauskas was a Lithuanian Nazi collaborator during World War II and alleged war criminal. At age 95 he stood to become the oldest person ever deported as a result of an investigation by the U.S. Justice Department's Office of Special Investigations (OSI).
